fr_html: Le PRESIDENT remercie M. Loder de ses aimables paroles. Il exprime le vœu que les liens de confraternité qui se sont formés entre les membres du Comité, persistent et que les membres se sentent toujours à l'avenir associés à l'œuvre qu'ils ont commencée.
en_html: The PRESIDENT thanked M. Loder for his kind words. He hoped that the ties established between the members of the Committee would endure, and that in the future the members would always feel their mutual association in the great work of which they had laid the foundations.
